Definition: middle voice (reflexively) of G568; to hold oneself off, i.e. refrain:--abstain.
BiblicalUsage: Hold yourself off — abstain from fornication, Paul tells the Thessalonians, and abstain from fleshly lusts, Peter tells the scattered believers. The middle voice makes it personal: nobody abstains for you; you hold yourself back.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe abstaining is not about missing out but about staying free for the life God has for me.
